page.title: Token Reporting
page.description: Token usage and request counts going through cortex-proxy

panel.truncated: The bar list shows the top {{shown}} of {{total}} entries. The table below has them all.

filter.hint: The range includes both dates and is counted in the cortex-proxy time zone (Europe/Warsaw, CET/CEST). Maximum range length: {{days}} days.

empty.noDataDescription: cortex-proxy recorded no requests in the selected date range.
empty.noMatchTitle: No data for the selected filters
empty.noMatchDescription: Change the model or scope, or widen the date range.

generic.title: Could not load the report
generic.message: Please try again in a moment.

cortex-proxy-not-configured.title: Report is not configured
cortex-proxy-not-configured.message: This instance has no cortex-proxy admin key set (CORTEX_PROXY_ADMIN_API_KEY). That is a configuration task for the instance administrator — all other tiles keep working.

cortex-proxy-unauthorized.title: cortex-proxy rejected the admin key
cortex-proxy-unauthorized.message: The key is set, but cortex-proxy does not accept it. Most common cause: CORTEX_PROXY_API_KEY was entered instead of CORTEX_PROXY_ADMIN_API_KEY — these are two different secrets.

cortex-proxy-unreachable.title: cortex-proxy is not responding
cortex-proxy-unreachable.message: Could not connect to cortex-proxy. Please try again in a moment.

cortex-proxy-error.title: Unexpected cortex-proxy response
cortex-proxy-error.message: cortex-proxy replied in a way we cannot read.

invalid-format.title: Invalid date format
invalid-format.message: Dates must use the YYYY-MM-DD format.

invalid-date.title: Invalid date
invalid-date.message: That date does not exist in the calendar.

reversed-range.title: Invalid date range
reversed-range.message: The start date cannot be later than the end date.

range-too-long.title: Range is too long
range-too-long.message: Pick a shorter period — the report covers at most one quarter.

forbidden.title: No access to the report
forbidden.message: Your account has no permission for this report. Ask the instance administrator to grant you access.

missing-email.title: Session has expired
missing-email.message: We cannot identify you. Sign in again and try once more.

internal-error.title: Server-side error
internal-error.message: Preparing the report failed. Please try again in a moment.

dataQuality.title: How to read these numbers
dataQuality.estimates: Some values are estimates, not readings from the provider API. When a model response carries no usage block, cortex-proxy stores a token count approximated from the request body. The report therefore shows the scale of usage, not a token-exact bill.
dataQuality.coverage: The report covers all traffic passing through cortex-proxy, including systems outside Cortex360. The “User” column holds the identifier sent by the calling system — usually an e-mail address, but that is not guaranteed.

requestCount.label: Requests
requestCount.description: Including failed requests, which consumed no tokens

activeUsers.label: Active users
activeUsers.withIdle: {{total}} visible, including users with no usage

cachedTokens.label: Cached tokens
cachedTokens.description: Some requests served from the provider cache

export.dataQualityNote: Some values are estimates: when the provider response carried no usage block, cortex-proxy records an approximate token count derived from the request payload.
